title: Gemini API
description: The Gemini API allows developers to build generative AI applications using Gemini models. Gemini is our most capable model, built from the ground up to be multimodal. It can generalize and seamlessly understand, operate across, and combine different types of information including language, images, audio, video, and code. You can use the Gemini API for use cases like reasoning across text and images, content generation, dialogue agents, summarization and classification systems, and more.

This list overrides the default settings for each `SafetyCategory` specified in the safety_settings. If there is no `SafetySetting` for a given `SafetyCategory` provided in the list, the API will use the default safety setting for that category. Harm categories HARM_CATEGORY_HATE_SPEECH, HARM_CATEGORY_SEXUALLY_EXPLICIT, HARM_CATEGORY_DANGEROUS_CONTENT, HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT are supported. Refer to the [guide](https://aistudio.google.com/docs/safety-settings) for detailed information on available safety settings. Also refer to the [Safety guidance](https://aistudio.google.com/docs/safety-guidance) to learn how to incorporate safety considerations in your AI applications.

model.description: Required. The name of the `Model` to use for generating the completion. Format: `models/{model}`.

displayName.description: Required. The user-defined name of this batch.

EmbedContentBatch.description: A resource representing a batch of `EmbedContent` requests.

id.description: Optional. Unique identifier of the `ExecutableCode` part. The server returns the `CodeExecutionResult` with the matching `id`.

code.description: Required. The code to be executed.

enumDescriptions: Unspecified language. This value should not be used.
Python >= 3.10, with numpy and simpy available. Python is the default language.

ExecutableCode.description: Code generated by the model that is meant to be executed, and the result returned to the model. Only generated when using the `CodeExecution` tool, in which the code will be automatically executed, and a corresponding `CodeExecutionResult` will also be generated.

words.description: Optional. Detailed word-level transcriptions and timing details. Present when word_timestamp is set.

text.description: Required. The transcription text of this audio segment.

speakerLabel.description: Optional. A label identifying the speaker of this audio segment (e.g. "spk_1", "spk_2"). Present when diarization is set.

AudioTranscription.description: The transcription of an audio part. For multi-speaker audio, each speaker segment is a separate Part with its own AudioTranscription carrying the speaker_label.

error.description: Output only. The error encountered while processing the request.

response.description: Output only. The response to the request.

metadata.description: Output only. The metadata associated with the request.

InlinedEmbedContentResponse.description: The response to a single request in the batch.
